summary: Vulcan Infrastructure & Power Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the September 10, 2026 closing of a previously announced private investment in public equity (PIPE) transaction, originally disclosed July 19, 2026. The issuer sold securities to MIG REF II INFR, LLC, an affiliate of Machine Investment Group, Atlas GREE Investment Holdco LLC, Conversant PIF Aggregator A LP and other investors including the CEO, CFO, President and a director. The excerpt states no price per share, premium, expected close or break fee; terms are incomplete and item 5.02 signals an officer change.
